## Module 15. 关键基因与汇报素材


### 15.1 Gene-centric evidence matrix

把 `ATAC`、`RNA`、`WGCNA`、`splicing`、`footprint`、`WGBS` 六层证据压成统一的 gene-centric 矩阵。当前 `Step15` 关键基因选择和 locus report 都优先从这里读。ATAC 与 RNA 的支持标记按用户指定的原始 pvalue 门计算；缺失 pvalue 不改用 FDR/padj，校正值保留为诊断列。RNA 使用显式输入的全部合格生物学样本结果；阈值见配置与结果定义表。

```{r gene_centric_evidence_matrix, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
gene_evidence_matrix <- data.frame()

gene_priority_tbl_step15 <- if(exists("multiomics_candidates")) multiomics_candidates else read_step_table("Step9", "Multiomics_Gene_Priority_Table.csv")
footprint_gene_tbl_step15 <- read_step_table("Step10", "Footprint_Supported_Gene_Summary.csv")
tf_target_edges_step15 <- read_step_table("Step10", "Footprint_Supported_Motif_Target_Edges.csv")
wgbs_support_tbl_step15 <- if(exists("wgbs_gene_centric_support")) wgbs_gene_centric_support else read_step_table("Step11", "wgbs_gene_centric_support.csv")
gene_priority_tbl_step15 <- ensure_columns(gene_priority_tbl_step15, list(
  ensembl_id = NA_character_,
  geneSymbol = NA_character_,
  MaxATACFold = NA_real_,
  RNA_log2FC = NA_real_,
  MaxDistalLinkScore = NA_real_,
  module_trait_correlation = NA_real_,
  is_splicing_candidate = FALSE,
  IntegratedPriorityScore = NA_real_,
  ATACEvidenceScore = NA_real_,
  RNAEvidenceScore = NA_real_,
  RegulatoryPositionScore = NA_real_,
  DistalEvidenceScore = NA_real_,
  WGCNAEvidenceScore = NA_real_,
  SplicingEvidenceScore = NA_real_,
  RNA_pvalue = NA_real_,
  RNA_padj = NA_real_,
  RNA_DE_pvalue = NA_real_,
  BestATACPvalue = NA_real_,
  BestATACFDR = NA_real_
))
footprint_gene_tbl_step15 <- ensure_columns(footprint_gene_tbl_step15, list(
  geneSymbol = NA_character_,
  MotifCount = NA_real_
))
tf_target_edges_step15 <- ensure_columns(tf_target_edges_step15, list(
  geneSymbol = NA_character_,
  motif_name = NA_character_
))
wgbs_support_tbl_step15 <- ensure_columns(wgbs_support_tbl_step15, list(
  gene_id_clean = NA_character_,
  geneSymbol = NA_character_,
  WGBS_StrongestLayer = NA_character_,
  WGBS_PrimaryMethDiff = NA_real_,
  WGBS_PrimaryHypomethylationScore = NA_real_,
  WGBS_MaxAbsMethy = NA_real_,
  WGBS_LayerCount = NA_real_,
  WGBS_PromoterMethDiff = NA_real_,
  WGBS_GeneBodyMethDiff = NA_real_,
  WGBS_CGIMethDiff = NA_real_,
  WGBS_DistalMethDiff = NA_real_
))

if(nrow(gene_priority_tbl_step15) > 0) {
  footprint_gene_support <- if(nrow(footprint_gene_tbl_step15) > 0) {
    footprint_gene_tbl_step15 %>%
      rename(geneSymbol = geneSymbol) %>%
      mutate(FootprintMotifCount = MotifCount)
  } else if(nrow(tf_target_edges_step15) > 0) {
    tf_target_edges_step15 %>%
      group_by(geneSymbol) %>%
      summarise(
        FootprintMotifCount = n_distinct(motif_name),
        FootprintMotifs = paste(sort(unique(motif_name)), collapse = ";"),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
  if(!"geneSymbol" %in% colnames(footprint_gene_support)) {
    footprint_gene_support <- data.frame(geneSymbol = character(), FootprintMotifCount = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  wgbs_step15_cols <- c(
    "WGBS_gene_id_clean", "WGBS_StrongestLayer", "WGBS_PrimaryMethDiff",
    "WGBS_PrimaryHypomethylationScore", "WGBS_MaxAbsMethy", "WGBS_LayerCount",
    "WGBS_PromoterMethDiff", "WGBS_GeneBodyMethDiff", "WGBS_CGIMethDiff", "WGBS_DistalMethDiff"
  )
  wgbs_step15_support <- wgbs_support_tbl_step15 %>%
    mutate(WGBS_gene_id_clean = gene_id_clean)
  wgbs_step15_by_id <- wgbs_step15_support %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_id_clean), gene_id_clean != "") %>%
    distinct(gene_id_clean, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, any_of(wgbs_step15_cols))
  wgbs_step15_by_symbol <- wgbs_step15_support %>%
    filter(!is.na(geneSymbol), geneSymbol != "") %>%
    distinct(geneSymbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(geneSymbol, any_of(wgbs_step15_cols)) %>%
    rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_symbol"), -geneSymbol)

  gene_evidence_joined <- gene_priority_tbl_step15 %>%
    left_join(
      footprint_gene_support %>%
        dplyr::select(any_of(c("geneSymbol", "FootprintMotifCount", "Motifs", "FootprintMotifs"))),
      by = "geneSymbol"
    ) %>%
    left_join(wgbs_step15_by_id, by = c("ensembl_id" = "gene_id_clean")) %>%
    left_join(
      wgbs_step15_by_symbol,
      by = "geneSymbol"
    )
  for(join_col in wgbs_step15_cols) {
    symbol_col <- paste0(join_col, "_symbol")
    if(join_col %in% colnames(gene_evidence_joined) && symbol_col %in% colnames(gene_evidence_joined)) {
      gene_evidence_joined[[join_col]] <- dplyr::coalesce(gene_evidence_joined[[join_col]], gene_evidence_joined[[symbol_col]])
    } else if(!join_col %in% colnames(gene_evidence_joined) && symbol_col %in% colnames(gene_evidence_joined)) {
      gene_evidence_joined[[join_col]] <- gene_evidence_joined[[symbol_col]]
    }
  }

  gene_evidence_matrix <- gene_evidence_joined %>%
    dplyr::select(-ends_with("_symbol")) %>%
    mutate(
      FootprintMotifCount = replace_na(FootprintMotifCount, 0),
      ATAC_support = is.finite(BestATACPvalue) & BestATACPvalue >= 0 & BestATACPvalue < atac_primary_p_cutoff &
        (!atac_primary_require_fc | abs(replace_na(MaxATACFold, 0)) >= atac_diff_log2fc_cutoff),
      RNA_support = is.finite(RNA_pvalue) & RNA_pvalue >= 0 & RNA_pvalue < 0.05 & abs(replace_na(RNA_log2FC, 0)) > 0.58,
      WGCNA_support = abs(replace_na(module_trait_correlation, 0)) >= 0.3,
      Splicing_support = replace_na(is_splicing_candidate, FALSE),
      Footprint_support = FootprintMotifCount > 0,
      WGBS_support = abs(replace_na(WGBS_MaxAbsMethy, 0)) >= 0.05,
      WGBSJoinMode = case_when(
        !is.na(ensembl_id) & ensembl_id != "" & ensembl_id == WGBS_gene_id_clean ~ "gene_id_clean",
        !is.na(WGBS_MaxAbsMethy) ~ "geneSymbol_fallback",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      ATAC_MaxFold = replace_na(MaxATACFold, 0),
      RNA_Log2FC = replace_na(RNA_log2FC, 0),
      Distal_LinkScore = replace_na(MaxDistalLinkScore, 0),
      WGCNA_Correlation = replace_na(module_trait_correlation, 0),
      Splicing_SupportNumeric = ifelse(Splicing_support, 1, 0),
      Footprint_TFSupport = replace_na(FootprintMotifCount, 0),
      WGBS_SupportMetric = replace_na(WGBS_MaxAbsMethy, 0),
      EvidenceLayerCount = ATAC_support + RNA_support + WGCNA_support + Splicing_support + Footprint_support + WGBS_support,
      FootprintEvidenceScore = round(10 * pmin(1, log2(FootprintMotifCount + 1) / 3), 2),
      WGBSEvidenceScore = round(10 * pmin(1, abs(replace_na(WGBS_MaxAbsMethy, 0)) / 0.25), 2),
      GeneCentricPriorityScore = round(pmin(100, replace_na(IntegratedPriorityScore, 0) + FootprintEvidenceScore + WGBSEvidenceScore), 2)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(EvidenceLayerCount), desc(GeneCentricPriorityScore), RNA_pvalue, BestATACPvalue)

  save_step_table(gene_evidence_matrix, "Step15", "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Matrix.csv")
  save_step_table(data.frame(
    Layer = c("ATAC", "RNA"), SignificanceMetric = c("BestATACPvalue", "RNA_pvalue"),
    Threshold = c(paste0("raw pvalue < ", atac_primary_p_cutoff,
                        if(atac_primary_require_fc) paste0(" and |log2FC| >= ", atac_diff_log2fc_cutoff) else "; no FC requirement"),
                  "raw pvalue < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.58"),
    MissingPvalue = "unavailable; no fallback to FDR/padj",
    DiagnosticColumns = c("BestATACFDR", "RNA_padj"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ), "Step15", "Gene_Evidence_Significance_Definitions.csv")

  evidence_long <- gene_evidence_matrix %>%
    dplyr::select(
      geneSymbol,
      GeneCentricPriorityScore,
      ATAC = ATAC_MaxFold,
      RNA = RNA_Log2FC,
      Distal = Distal_LinkScore,
      WGCNA = WGCNA_Correlation,
      Splicing = Splicing_SupportNumeric,
      Footprint = Footprint_TFSupport,
      WGBS = WGBS_SupportMetric,
      ATACScore = ATACEvidenceScore,
      RNAScore = RNAEvidenceScore,
      RegulatoryScore = RegulatoryPositionScore,
      DistalScore = DistalEvidenceScore,
      WGCNAScore = WGCNAEvidenceScore,
      SplicingScore = SplicingEvidenceScore,
      FootprintScore = FootprintEvidenceScore,
      WGBSScore = WGBSEvidenceScore
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(geneSymbol, GeneCentricPriorityScore), names_to = "EvidenceType", values_to = "EvidenceValue") %>%
    group_by(EvidenceType) %>%
    mutate(ScaledEvidence = ifelse(all(is.na(EvidenceValue)) || max(abs(EvidenceValue), na.rm = TRUE) == 0, 0, abs(EvidenceValue) / max(abs(EvidenceValue), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    ungroup()
  save_step_table(evidence_long, "Step15", "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Long.csv")

  if(nrow(gene_evidence_matrix) > 0 && should_render_plots()) {
    top_evidence_genes <- gene_evidence_matrix %>%
      filter(!is.na(geneSymbol) & geneSymbol != "") %>%
      slice_head(n = 30) %>%
      pull(geneSymbol)

    evidence_long_top <- evidence_long %>%
      filter(geneSymbol %in% top_evidence_genes, EvidenceType %in% c("ATAC", "RNA", "Distal", "WGCNA", "Splicing", "Footprint", "WGBS")) %>%
      mutate(
        geneSymbol = factor(geneSymbol, levels = rev(top_evidence_genes)),
        EvidenceType = factor(EvidenceType, levels = c("ATAC", "RNA", "Distal", "WGCNA", "Splicing", "Footprint", "WGBS"))
      )

    p_evidence_tile <- ggplot(evidence_long_top, aes(x = EvidenceType, y = geneSymbol, fill = ScaledEvidence)) +
      geom_tile(color = viz_pal$neutral["light"], linewidth = 0.25) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colors = viz_pal$heat_meth, limits = c(0, 1)) +
      theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
      labs(
        title = "Gene-centric evidence matrix",
        subtitle = "Top candidate genes ranked by multi-layer evidence",
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL,
        fill = "Scaled evidence"
      )
    save_plot_pdf(p_evidence_tile, step_plot_file("Step15", "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Matrix.pdf"), width = 10, height = 9)

    top_ranked_genes <- gene_evidence_matrix %>%
      filter(geneSymbol %in% top_evidence_genes) %>%
      mutate(geneSymbol = factor(geneSymbol, levels = rev(top_evidence_genes)))

    p_evidence_rank <- ggplot(
      top_ranked_genes,
      aes(x = geneSymbol, y = GeneCentricPriorityScore, fill = EvidenceLayerCount)
    ) +
      geom_col(width = 0.72) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_gradientn(colors = viz_pal$heat_warm) +
      theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
      labs(
        title = "Gene-centric evidence ranking",
        subtitle = "Top candidate genes ranked by integrated cross-omics support",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Gene-centric priority score",
        fill = "Evidence layers"
      )
    save_plot_pdf(p_evidence_rank, step_plot_file("Step15", "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Ranking.pdf"), width = 9, height = 8)
  }
} else {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step15",
    "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Matrix",
    "Missing Step9 multi-omics candidate table.",
    clear_plot_files = c("Gene_Centric_Evidence_Matrix.pdf", "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Ranking.pdf")
  )
}
```

```{r recompute_keygenes_and_locus, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
step15_table_dir <- step_table_dir("Step15")
step15_plot_dir <- step_plot_dir("Step15")
dir.create(file.path(step15_plot_dir, "locus_reports"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
if(!exists("wgbs_rep_loci") || !is.data.frame(wgbs_rep_loci)) {
  wgbs_rep_loci <- read_step_table("Step11", "wgbs_representative_loci.csv")
}
if(!exists("wgbs_gene_centric_support") || !is.data.frame(wgbs_gene_centric_support)) {
  wgbs_gene_centric_support <- read_step_table("Step11", "wgbs_gene_centric_support.csv")
}
if(!exists("multiomics_candidates") || !is.data.frame(multiomics_candidates)) {
  multiomics_candidates <- read_step_table("Step9", "Multiomics_Gene_Priority_Table.csv")
}

gene_evidence_matrix <- if(exists("gene_evidence_matrix") && is.data.frame(gene_evidence_matrix)) {
  gene_evidence_matrix
} else {
  read_step_table("Step15", "Gene_Centric_Evidence_Matrix.csv")
}

if(nrow(gene_evidence_matrix) == 0) {
  unlink(file.path(step15_plot_dir, "locus_reports"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
  dir.create(file.path(step15_plot_dir, "locus_reports"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step15",
    "Key_Genes_and_Locus",
    "Missing gene-centric evidence matrix; integrated key-gene reporting skipped.",
    clear_plot_files = c("key_genes_accessibility.pdf")
  )
}

key_genes <- if(nrow(gene_evidence_matrix) > 0) {
  gene_evidence_matrix %>%
    filter(!is.na(geneSymbol) & geneSymbol != "") %>%
    arrange(desc(GeneCentricPriorityScore), desc(EvidenceLayerCount), RNA_pvalue, BestATACPvalue) %>%
    slice_head(n = 15) %>%
    pull(geneSymbol) %>%
    unique()
} else {
  character(0)
}
if(nrow(wgbs_rep_loci) > 0 && "geneSymbol" %in% colnames(wgbs_rep_loci)) {
  key_genes <- unique(c(key_genes, wgbs_rep_loci$geneSymbol[!is.na(wgbs_rep_loci$geneSymbol) & wgbs_rep_loci$geneSymbol != ""]))
}

annotated_top_peaks <- data.frame()
if(exists("diff_anno_df") && is.data.frame(diff_anno_df) && nrow(diff_anno_df) > 0) {
  annotated_top_peaks <- diff_anno_df
} else {
  annotated_peak_candidates <- c(step_table_file("Step7", "Annotated_DiffPeaks.csv"))
  annotated_peak_file <- annotated_peak_candidates[file.exists(annotated_peak_candidates)][1]
  if(length(annotated_peak_file) > 0 && !is.na(annotated_peak_file)) {
    annotated_top_peaks <- read.csv(annotated_peak_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
}
if("SYMBOL" %in% colnames(annotated_top_peaks) && !"geneSymbol" %in% colnames(annotated_top_peaks)) {
  colnames(annotated_top_peaks)[colnames(annotated_top_peaks) == "SYMBOL"] <- "geneSymbol"
}
if(!"geneSymbol" %in% colnames(annotated_top_peaks)) {
  annotated_top_peaks$geneSymbol <- NA_character_
}
if(nrow(annotated_top_peaks) > 0 && "seqnames" %in% colnames(annotated_top_peaks)) {
  annotated_top_peaks$seqnames <- ifelse(
    grepl("^chr", annotated_top_peaks$seqnames),
    annotated_top_peaks$seqnames,
    paste0("chr", annotated_top_peaks$seqnames)
  )
}

if(nrow(annotated_top_peaks) > 0 && length(key_genes) > 0) {
  key_gene_peaks <- annotated_top_peaks %>%
    mutate(peak_id = paste(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":")) %>%
    filter(geneSymbol %in% key_genes) %>%
    left_join(
      res_df %>%
        mutate(
          seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(seqnames),
          peak_id = paste(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":")
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(peak_id, Fold_resdf = Fold, FDR_resdf = FDR),
      by = "peak_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Fold = dplyr::coalesce(Fold_resdf, Fold),
      FDR = dplyr::coalesce(FDR_resdf, FDR)
    )

  if(nrow(wgbs_gene_centric_support) > 0) {
    key_gene_peaks <- key_gene_peaks %>%
      left_join(
        wgbs_gene_centric_support %>%
          dplyr::select(
            geneSymbol, WGBS_StrongestLayer, WGBS_PrimaryMethDiff, WGBS_MaxAbsMethy,
            WGBS_PrimaryHypomethylationScore, WGBS_PromoterMethDiff, WGBS_CGIMethDiff, WGBS_DistalMethDiff
          ),
        by = "geneSymbol"
      )
  }

  if(nrow(wgbs_rep_loci) > 0 && "geneSymbol" %in% colnames(wgbs_rep_loci)) {
    key_gene_peaks <- key_gene_peaks %>%
      mutate(WGBS_RepresentativeLocus = geneSymbol %in% wgbs_rep_loci$geneSymbol)
  }
  write.csv(key_gene_peaks, file.path(step15_table_dir, "key_gene_peaks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  p_key_full <- ggplot(key_gene_peaks,
                       aes(x = reorder(geneSymbol, Fold), y = Fold,
                           fill = factor(Fold > 0, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = viz_pal$neutral["dark"]) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_named(
      `FALSE` = viz_pal$group[reference_group],
      `TRUE` = viz_pal$group[comparison_group]
    )) +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = "Accessibility changes at report-priority genes",
      x = NULL,
      y = paste("ATAC log2FC (", contrast_label, ")"),
      fill = "Comparison open"
    )
  save_plot_pdf(p_key_full, file.path(step15_plot_dir, "key_genes_accessibility.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5)
}

plot_locus_report <- function(gene_symbol) {
  gene_info <- if(nrow(multiomics_candidates) > 0) {
    multiomics_candidates %>%
      filter(geneSymbol == gene_symbol) %>%
      arrange(desc(IntegratedPriorityScore)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1)
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
  wgbs_info <- if(nrow(wgbs_gene_centric_support) > 0) {
    wgbs_gene_centric_support %>%
      filter(geneSymbol == gene_symbol) %>%
      arrange(desc(WGBS_MaxAbsMethy)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1)
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }

  entrez_id <- suppressWarnings(mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = gene_symbol, column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first"))
  if(is.na(entrez_id) || entrez_id == "") {
    return(data.frame(geneSymbol = gene_symbol, status = "missing_entrez", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  gene_gr_ucsc <- genes(txdb)
  target_gene <- gene_gr_ucsc[gene_gr_ucsc$gene_id %in% as.character(entrez_id)]
  if(length(target_gene) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(geneSymbol = gene_symbol, status = "missing_gene_range", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  target_gene <- target_gene[1]
  chr_ucsc <- as.character(seqnames(target_gene))
  chr_bam <- sub("^chr", "", chr_ucsc)
  locus_start <- max(1, start(target_gene) - 20000)
  locus_end <- end(target_gene) + 20000

  txdb_ncbi <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm39.refGene
  tryCatch({ seqlevelsStyle(txdb_ncbi) <- "NCBI" }, error = function(e) NULL)
  plot_chr <- if(any(grepl("^chr", seqlevels(txdb_ncbi)))) chr_ucsc else chr_bam

  axis_track <- GenomeAxisTrack()
  gene_track <- GeneRegionTrack(
    txdb_ncbi, chromosome = plot_chr, start = locus_start, end = locus_end,
    name = "Genes", transcriptAnnotation = "symbol"
  )

  peak_region_df <- res_df %>%
    mutate(seqnames = ensure_ucsc_seqnames(seqnames)) %>%
    filter(seqnames == chr_ucsc, end >= locus_start, start <= locus_end)

  peak_tracks <- list()
  if(nrow(peak_region_df) > 0) {
    pfos_peak_gr <- GRanges(
      seqnames = peak_region_df$seqnames[peak_region_df$Fold > 0],
      ranges = IRanges(start = peak_region_df$start[peak_region_df$Fold > 0], end = peak_region_df$end[peak_region_df$Fold > 0])
    )
    wt_peak_gr <- GRanges(
      seqnames = peak_region_df$seqnames[peak_region_df$Fold < 0],
      ranges = IRanges(start = peak_region_df$start[peak_region_df$Fold < 0], end = peak_region_df$end[peak_region_df$Fold < 0])
    )
    if(!grepl("^chr", plot_chr)) {
      if(length(pfos_peak_gr) > 0) seqlevelsStyle(pfos_peak_gr) <- "NCBI"
      if(length(wt_peak_gr) > 0) seqlevelsStyle(wt_peak_gr) <- "NCBI"
    }
    if(length(pfos_peak_gr) > 0) {
      peak_tracks <- c(peak_tracks, list(
        AnnotationTrack(range = pfos_peak_gr, chromosome = plot_chr, name = comparison_open_label,
                        fill = viz_pal$group[treatment_group], col = viz_pal$group[treatment_group])
      ))
    }
    if(length(wt_peak_gr) > 0) {
      peak_tracks <- c(peak_tracks, list(
        AnnotationTrack(range = wt_peak_gr, chromosome = plot_chr, name = reference_open_label,
                        fill = viz_pal$group[baseline_group], col = viz_pal$group[baseline_group])
      ))
    }
  }

  rep_samples <- unname(vapply(group_levels, function(group_name) {
    group_sample <- sample_manifest$sample[sample_manifest$group == group_name]
    if(length(group_sample) == 0) NA_character_ else group_sample[1]
  }, character(1)))
  rep_bams <- bam_files[rep_samples]
  rep_bams <- rep_bams[file.exists(rep_bams)]
  data_tracks <- lapply(seq_along(rep_bams), function(i) {
    sample_name <- names(rep_bams)[i]
    sample_group_name <- sample_group(sample_name)
    DataTrack(
      range = rep_bams[i], genome = "mm39", type = "histogram", name = sample_name,
      chromosome = chr_bam, start = locus_start, end = locus_end,
      col.histogram = viz_color(group_colors, sample_group_name),
      fill.histogram = viz_color(group_colors, sample_group_name)
    )
  })

  output_file <- file.path(step15_plot_dir, "locus_reports", paste0(gene_symbol, "_locus_report.pdf"))
  title_parts <- c(gene_symbol)
  if(nrow(gene_info) > 0) {
    title_parts <- c(
      title_parts,
      paste0("RNA=", round(gene_info$RNA_log2FC[1], 2)),
      paste0("MaxATAC=", round(gene_info$MaxATACFold[1], 2)),
      paste0("Score=", round(gene_info$IntegratedPriorityScore[1], 2))
    )
  }
  if(nrow(wgbs_info) > 0) {
    if("WGBS_PrimaryMethDiff" %in% colnames(wgbs_info) && !is.na(wgbs_info$WGBS_PrimaryMethDiff[1])) {
      title_parts <- c(title_parts, paste0("WGBS=", round(wgbs_info$WGBS_PrimaryMethDiff[1], 2)))
    }
    if("WGBS_StrongestLayer" %in% colnames(wgbs_info) && !is.na(wgbs_info$WGBS_StrongestLayer[1])) {
      title_parts <- c(title_parts, paste0("Layer=", wgbs_info$WGBS_StrongestLayer[1]))
    }
  }

  tryCatch({
    draw_gviz_dual(
      output_file,
      width = 11,
      height = 7,
      plotTracks(
        c(list(axis_track, gene_track), peak_tracks, data_tracks),
        from = locus_start,
        to = locus_end,
        chromosome = chr_bam,
        main = paste(title_parts, collapse = " | ")
      )
    )
    data.frame(geneSymbol = gene_symbol, status = "ok", output_file = output_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    try(dev.off(), silent = TRUE)
    data.frame(geneSymbol = gene_symbol, status = paste0("plot_failed: ", e$message), output_file = output_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
}

locus_priority_genes <- unique(c(
  head(key_genes, 8),
  if(nrow(gene_evidence_matrix) > 0) {
    head(gene_evidence_matrix$geneSymbol[order(-gene_evidence_matrix$GeneCentricPriorityScore)], 8)
  } else {
    character(0)
  }
))
locus_priority_genes <- locus_priority_genes[!is.na(locus_priority_genes) & locus_priority_genes != ""]

if(length(locus_priority_genes) > 0) {
  representative_loci_tbl <- data.frame(
    geneSymbol = locus_priority_genes,
    PriorityRank = seq_along(locus_priority_genes),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      gene_evidence_matrix %>%
        dplyr::select(
          geneSymbol, GeneCentricPriorityScore, EvidenceLayerCount,
          ATAC_MaxFold, RNA_Log2FC, Footprint_TFSupport, WGBS_SupportMetric
        ),
      by = "geneSymbol"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      if(nrow(wgbs_rep_loci) > 0) {
        ensure_columns(wgbs_rep_loci, list(geneSymbol = NA_character_)) %>%
          mutate(WGBS_Representative = TRUE) %>%
          dplyr::select(geneSymbol, WGBS_Representative)
      } else {
        data.frame(geneSymbol = character(), WGBS_Representative = logical(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      },
      by = "geneSymbol"
    ) %>%
    mutate(WGBS_Representative = replace_na(WGBS_Representative, FALSE))
  save_step_table(representative_loci_tbl, "Step15", "Representative_Loci.csv")
}

if(length(locus_priority_genes) > 0) {
  locus_manifest <- bind_rows(lapply(locus_priority_genes, plot_locus_report))
  write.csv(locus_manifest, file.path(step15_table_dir, "Locus_Report_Manifest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r step14_15_visualization, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
wgbs_candidates_plot <- read_step_table("Step11", "atac_wgbs_gene_centric_candidates.csv")
key_gene_peaks_plot <- read_step_table("Step15", "key_gene_peaks.csv")

if(nrow(wgbs_candidates_plot) > 0) {
  top_wgbs <- wgbs_candidates_plot %>%
    filter(!is.na(WGBS_PrimaryMethDiff), !is.na(MaxATACFold)) %>%
    arrange(desc(IntegratedPriorityScore), desc(WGBS_MaxAbsMethy)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20)

  p_wgbs <- ggplot(
    top_wgbs,
    aes(x = WGBS_PrimaryMethDiff, y = MaxATACFold, color = IntegratedPriorityScore,
        size = pmax(abs(replace_na(RNA_log2FC, 0)), 0.25))
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = viz_pal$neutral_dark) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = viz_pal$neutral_dark) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.78) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = geneSymbol), size = 3, max.overlaps = 30) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = viz_pal$heat_meth) +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = "ATAC-WGBS gene-centric concordance", x = "WGBS primary methylation diff", y = "Max ATAC log2FC")
  print(p_wgbs)
}

if(nrow(key_gene_peaks_plot) > 0) {
  key_plot_df <- key_gene_peaks_plot %>%
    filter(!is.na(geneSymbol) & geneSymbol != "") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(Fold))) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20)

  p_key <- ggplot(
    key_plot_df,
    aes(x = reorder(geneSymbol, Fold), y = Fold,
        fill = factor(Fold > 0, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_named(
      `FALSE` = viz_pal$group[reference_group],
      `TRUE` = viz_pal$group[comparison_group]
    )) +
    theme_atac_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = "Accessibility changes at key report genes", x = NULL, y = "ATAC log2FC", fill = comparison_open_label)
  print(p_key)
}
```
